notes: Rattler: scrap gremlins who live in Rusthold's walls. THE SMALL RIG (kind "small": 25x25, pivot (12,12)): legs, torso and every head stay inside the central 15x15 (pivot +-7), so the body fits the 1x1 cell of the trait `body` 1 and a 1-wide crawlspace; only the thin arms reach beyond it, out to the shared mounts (the human's, moved by (-4,-4): item top-left = mount - item.grip as everywhere; hand anchors are art only). Gunmetal-grey skin, two huge pink-lined ears, brass goggles with blue glass, rust leather gloves and boots, a tool belt that bristles with a wrench, a screwdriver and a hammer. Head variants: goggles (over the eyes), pushed (goggles up on the brow, bright eyes), helmet (a bucket hard hat with a lamp, tinted). Outfit mask = the overalls, the knee patches, the hard hat. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 25x25 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee. RIG KIND small: this frame is 25x25 with the pivot at (12,12), so every mount here is the shared one moved by (-4,-4): mount - pivot is identical to the human rig. The hand anchors are art only (kept inside the frame).
